paper_title: PM-KVQ Progressive Mixed-precision KV Cache Quantization for Long-CoT   LLMs
caption: : DeepSeek-R1-Distill-LLaMA-70B
model_annotation: The bar chart illustrates per-block “Sensitivity” values across transformer blocks for the model (captioned DeepSeek-R1-Distill-LLaMA-70B), with bars colored by a two-level precision designation shown in the legend (blue = “4-Fbit”, green = “2-Fbit”). The horizontal axis contains the categories as “Block Index”, running from 0 to 79 with labeled ticks at 0, 19, 39, 59, and 79, and the bars are placed at successive integer indices. The vertical axis is labeled “Sensitivity” and uses a logarithmic scale, with major tick labels shown at approximately \(10^{-6}\), \(10^{-5}\), and \(10^{-4}\), and the plotted values spanning from below \(10^{-6}\) up to slightly above \(10^{-4}\). Most bars from early indices are green (2-Fbit), with heights generally around the \(10^{-6}\) decade (e.g., several near \(\sim 1\times10^{-6}\) to \(\sim 5\times10^{-6}\)), and a few dipping below \(10^{-6}\) (down to a few \(\times 10^{-7}\)); around the mid-40s to high-50s there is a mix where some blue (4-Fbit) bars appear among green bars, with blue heights in this region around several \(\times 10^{-6}\) (near the lower end of the \(10^{-5}\) decade). From roughly block index 59 through 79, the bars are predominantly blue (4-Fbit) and rise into and within the \(10^{-5}\) decade, with later blocks reaching near \(10^{-4}\) and the tallest bar at the far right slightly above \(10^{-4}\) (around \(\sim 1\text{–}2\times10^{-4}\)). The bars are not presented as stacked or grouped within each index (each index shows a single bar with a single color), and there are no additional visual emphasis elements such as outlines, annotations, or explicit sorting beyond the natural increasing order of block indices.
